title: FolumX : The Dungeon Tapes
description: A music disc expansion mod for the virtual artist FolumX
body:
![FolumX Minecraftified](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28d76d7bc38c714337e008cc667e48f9527696aa.jpeg) # 💿 FolumX Music Discs ### *The greatest artist of our generation* ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1-62B47A?style=for-the-badge) ![Forge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge-47.2.0+-1F2D3D?style=for-the-badge) ![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-20.1.77+-F16436?style=for-the-badge) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-0.15+-355A6F?style=for-the-badge) ![Quilt](https://img.shields.io/badge/Quilt-0.23+-9722EB?style=for-the-badge) **10 hand-picked tracks · USB-C · Lost Tapes · ready to be discovered in the world**
--- ## 🎧 The Pitch This mod brings **10 of FolumX's greatest hits** straight from his landmark albums *USB-C* and *Lost Tapes* into Minecraft 1.20.1. No new tabs. No clutter. No nonsense. Just legendary records sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with the vanilla discs, waiting to be **unearthed in the wild** and slammed into a jukebox. > If you've ever wanted to hear *AFTERHOURS..* echoing through a deepslate cavern at 3 AM, or *summit ^* playing the moment you crest a mountain you spent an hour climbing — **this mod was made for that exact moment.** --- ## 🌟 Why FolumX? Because he's it. Full stop. *USB-C* and *Lost Tapes* are generation-defining bodies of work, and the songs on this mod are the cuts that hit hardest — the ones built for blasting at sunrise on top of a mountain, for staring out at the ocean, for that long walk back to base after surviving something you shouldn't have. **This isn't a novelty disc pack. This is a love letter.** --- ## 📀 The Tracklist | # | Track | | :-: | :-- | | 01 | **FolumX — AFTERHOURS.. (dylanjkl Remix)** | | 02 | **FolumX — BASS..** | | 03 | **FolumX — CITYLITE..** | | 04 | **FolumX — City of Gold (Bonus)** *(feat. Big xD)* | | 05 | **FolumX — crawl --** | | 06 | **FolumX — frequency /\\** | | 07 | **FolumX — peace .** | | 08 | **FolumX — summit ^** | | 09 | **FolumX — THE SURGE..** | | 10 | **FolumX — \* turn up the light \*** *(ft. dylanjkl)* | --- ## 🗺️ Find in World ### ⛏️ In Survival Every disc is a **rare drop** in dungeon-style chests across the world. Crack open one of these and you might walk away with a track that changes how the rest of your run *feels*: - 🏰 **Simple Dungeon** - 🌌 **Ancient City** - 🏖️ **Buried Treasure** - 🏛️ **Woodland Mansion** ### 🎨 In Creative Flip to the **Tools & Utilities** tab. The FolumX discs are slotted in right after `Music Disc Pigstep`, sharing the panel with the vanilla records like they belong there. Because they do. ### 🎶 In Any Jukebox They play **exactly like vanilla discs**. Hopper-friendly. Comparator-friendly. Redstone-friendly. --- ## 🛠️ Compatibility Built for **Minecraft 1.20.1**. Drop the matching JAR into your mods folder and you're set. | | Loader | Required versions | | :-: | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | | 🔨 | **Forge** | Forge **47.2.0+** | | ⚒️ | **NeoForge** | NeoForge **20.1.77+** | | 🧵 | **Fabric** | Fabric Loader **0.15+** · Fabric API **0.92.0+1.20.1** | | 🪡 | **Quilt** | Quilt Loader **0.23+** · QFAPI **7.3.1+** | > ✅ Works on both **client and server** > ✅ **Multiplayer-safe** > ✅ **No extra dependencies** (besides Fabric API on Fabric / Quilt) --- ## 🎤 Listen to FolumX If this mod made you a fan, do the right thing — **stream the man:**
👉 [**FolumX on Spotify**](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0v1Ut4k8ypW6X0xHOJTO4T) 👈
